question: Can I vote absentee in the next election?

In Bartlett, you may vote by absentee ballot if you meet specific criteria. A delivery agent must present a government-issued photo identification or have their identity verified by the clerk and complete a form [L1, L4]. Family members, nursing home and elder care facility administrators, and a person assisting a voter with a disability (for up to four voters) can act as delivery agents [L1, L4].
